Overview.Name: Srividya Kasireddy
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal, avoids non-veg on Monday, Thursday and Saturday

Meal_1: Option 1: Egg omelette (2–3 eggs) + cooked vegetables
Option 2: Paneer pan fried (120 g) + cucumber slices
Meal_2 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & fish curry (120 g) & curd
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (120 g) & vegetable fry
Meal_3 (Dinner - light): Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) + Egg bhurji (2 eggs) + cooked vegetables
Option 3: Vegetable soup + paneer cubes (120 g)

Notes_and_Tips: Avoid non-veg on Monday, Thursday and Saturday and follow vegetarian options.
Improving sleep will help reduce stress and improve thyroid balance.
Start meals with eggs, paneer or curd before eating rice.
Keep dinner lighter on stressful work days.
Walking daily after meals will support digestion and improve energy.
